title: Kissed Trifle Dessert
description: A classic English trifle dessert with a modern twist, featuring kissed ladyfingers and crunchy polish cookies.

ingredients.name: Whipped Cream
ingredients.notes: Heavy cream whipped to stiff peaks

instructions: Begin by kissing the ladyfingers with melted butter and setting them aside.
Crush the Polish cookies and mix with granulated sugar.
In a large serving dish, create a layer of crushed cookies.
Arrange the kissed ladyfingers on top of the cookie layer.
Spread a layer of whipped cream over the ladyfingers.
Add a layer of fresh berries on top of the whipped cream.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of whipped cream.
Drizzle with vanilla extract and serve chilled.
